t: Pernik Province - Wikipedia
s: November 9, 2025 - Pernik Province is a province in western Bulgaria, neighbouring Serbia. Its main city is Pernik, and other municipalities are Breznik, Kovachevtsi, Radomir, Tran, and Zemen. Pernik province had a population of 133,750 according to the 2011 census, of which 48.9% were male and 51.1% were female.
